subject: vt-dy
title: VT.DY.-----DIS.C.CT.
description: First of two diagrams in MP(II)-11. The crossing diagrams how vibrational-dynamics structurally meets disintegration of a culture's center. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics — what the form's actual vibrational working consists of) is crossed with DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture's center). VT-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; TR rises from the main line, EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) branches from the TR line to the upper-right, and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branches from the EXP-DY line. INFO-COMP (information compression) branches from the main line out to the right margin, AFN (affinity negation) branches from the INFO-COMP line, and IF-SPT (infra-spirituality) from the AFN line. POL-DY (political dynamics) branches from the main line to the center-left; PART (participation) drops from the POL-DY line, ECO-DYM (economic dynamics) branches from the PART line, and POL-P (political policies) from the ECO-DYM line.
